text.text_excerpt: Robert is fantastic! I almost feel that it's similar to Whole Foods, minus the attitude, if that makes sense. I happened to be in the neighborhood and I had to pick up some supplies for a co-worker's birthday and Robert had just the stuff. I found some catering trays that were ready to go and a doberge cake that I was able to pick up, without having to order ahead. While this store is fairly small, they have a nice variety of things to choose from and the prices are reasonable.

The biggest Robert's Fresh Market of the three! I have some cousins that live near this Roberts, but I hasn't been here for a while. We went today because we are dog sitting for my SO's cousin. I forgot how much more selection it has! Whenever I go to the Robert's uptown, I make sure to take a glance at the baked goods because they always vary from my Metairie home store. The lakeview store has a combination of items from both stores, plus a little more. I particularly like the indoor and outdoor seating areas - would be a great place to grab lunch. Altogether, this is a great Robert's store just like the other two. The only drawback I can see is that the employees are not as friendly as ...

I stop by Robert maybe two or three times a week on my way home from UNO since it's directly on my route. Yes, the prices are higher than other groceries on most items but you can actually find good deals if you're getting fresh vegetables and such. Also, the seafood is high quality and reasonably priced. The prepared food is actually really good. On occasion I would take the trip there from UNO to get lunch or hit the salad & olive bar. And I must admit, I have a weak spot for their sushi. It's the best grocery store sushi I've found and priced about the same as you'd find in a restaurant for many of the rolls.
